name: Minase Nozomi
source: [spoiler]Nozomi have terminal illness that hard to cured. Her illness is genetic disease for female in her family and the patient will have short life span that make them die in young age. This disease have unusual trait that make the patient different from normal human like regeneration speed. If the patient receive wound that can leave scar or more serious than that, it can recovery more fast than normal human from a several minutes until several days depend on the wound. That is applied to condition like anemia too where after give a huge amount of blood that can make her faint that recovered just by sleep for a night. This disease even contribute to give abnormal antibody to the patient that where strong dose of opium can make normal human lose their sanity but in her case she only recognize it as "normal fever" and cured in several day.[/spoiler]
